entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 300 to 350 mm of rain in addition to rain which has already accumulated. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected Monday morning and afternoon. Freezing level about 2600 metres. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal. Changes: Rainfall totals increased period extended.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 220 to 280 mm of rain about the main divide, and 90 to 140 mm within 15 km farther east. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected Monday morning and afternoon about the divide. Freezing level about 2600 m. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.

entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: Northwest winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.
